design.name: 蜃楼蟾
design.brief: A giant desert mirage toad, the artillery: a squat, wide warty toad with sandstone-coloured skin and Dunhuang turquoise spots, carrying half of a collapsed Buddhist pagoda (tiered roof, bells, cracked bricks) grown into its back. A huge translucent throat sac glowing white-gold, puffed up and about to spit a fire ball (weak spot). Heat shimmer and faint mirage copies around it. Thick front legs with four stubby fingers and webbing, big hind legs with five webbed toes.
design.turnaround_pose: on all four legs, mouth closed, throat sac glowing and half inflated, the pagoda on its back fully shown
design.turnaround_digits: front feet with four separate stubby webbed toes and hind feet with five separate webbed toes, clearly countable.
